Best in Slot Gear for Subtlety Rogue
Subtlety Rogues aim for a mix of stats and an active trinket combined with a passive option.


Slot	Item	Source
Head	 Masquerade of the Grim Jest	Tier Set
Neck	 Eternal Voidsong Chain	Crown of the Cosmos
Shoulders	 Venom Casks of the Grim Jest	Tier Set
Cloak	 Rigid Scale Greatcloak	Skyreach
Chest	 Fantastic Finery of the Grim Jest	Tier Set
Wrist	 Void-Skinned Bracers	Vorasius
Gloves	 Sleight of Hand of the Grim Jest	Tier Set
Belt	 Silvermoon Agent's Utility Belt	Crafting
Legs	 Shaggy Wyrmleather Leggings	Pit of Saron
Boots	 Boots of Burning Focus	Skyreach
Ring	 Platinum Star Band	Algeth'ar Academy
Ring	 Bifurcation Band	Magister's Terrace
Trinket	 Light Company Guidon	Imperator Averzian
Trinket	 Gaze of the Alnseer	Chimaerus
Weapon	 Hungering Victory	Vorasius
Offhand	 Farstrider's Mercy	Crafting

At the start of the season, resources and gear are very limited, and the first few crafted pieces are crucial for progressing efficiently. Here is the best early crafting order for Subtlety Rogue using  Spark of Radiance, targeting the quickest power gains:
Craft  Farstrider's Mercy with  Darkmoon Sigil: Hunt . Explanation 
Craft  Silvermoon Agent's Utility Belt with  Arcanoweave Lining . Explanation 
Replace Low Item Level Pieces.
Missive:
Use  Thalassian Missive of the Feverflare  or  Thalassian Missive of the Peerless .
